notes: Fixed inputs named by a label are SHA-256(UTF-8("agora-test-vectors/" || label)), truncated to the stated length.
contentKey is fixed here; the spec requires a fresh random key per file.
Chunk size is fixed at 262,144 bytes by the spec (Appendix C), so the multi-chunk case uses a 263,144-byte file (2 chunks).
nonce[i] = i as 96-bit big-endian; aad[i] = "agora/chunk/v1" || uint64be(i) || uint64be(n) || uint8(final). block = ciphertext || 16-byte tag.
The dag-pb root block and its CID are NOT included: the root block encoding is underspecified (see README, ambiguities).

vectors.name: two-chunk
vectors.pattern: byte j of the file = j mod 251, for j in 0 .. 263143 (262144 + 1000 bytes)
